description: The user is doing some general reading across different magazines and newspapers, initially researching tech and hardware startups before pivoting their focus to personal finance and investment strategies.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_2]
Query: Can you search the web to find the name of the CEO of the company that built the robot shown in this image, and create a note with their name?
Instructions: Ask the agent to look at the provided image, identify the company that built the robot shown, search the web to find the name of their CEO, and create a note recording this name. If the agent asks for the company name, direct it to look at the logo on the robot's body. Once the note is created, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_3]
Query: Now look at the red box at the bottom of this page. Search the web to see if that CEO was ever a guest on this podcast, and update the note with any episodes you find.
Instructions: Provide the second image and ask the agent to identify the podcast advertised in the red box at the bottom. Instruct it to search the web to check if the CEO it just found was ever a guest on this podcast, and update the note with the results. If the agent needs help finding the podcast name, point it to the red call-out box. Wait for the note to be updated before moving on.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_1]
Query: Actually, let's pivot my research entirely to personal finance. Delete that robotics note. Instead, look at this new article. Search the web for the Barclays Smart Investor director mentioned here to find her recent advice on the strategy highlighted in the blue quote box, and create a new note summarizing her tips.
Instructions: Tell the agent you've changed your mind and want to pivot to personal finance. Ask it to delete the previous note. Then, provide the third image and ask the agent to find the name of the Barclays Smart Investor director mentioned in the text. Instruct it to search the web for her recent advice on the investment strategy highlighted in the blue quote box, and create a new note summarizing her tips. If the agent asks which strategy, direct it to the blue box with quotation marks. Once the new note is created, proceed.

ROUND 4
Query: Set a reminder for tomorrow at 9:00 AM to review this new finance note.
Instructions: Ask the agent to set a reminder for tomorrow at 9:00 AM to review the newly created finance note. Once the reminder is successfully scheduled, end the conversation.

entity_data.title: Clare Francis - Pound Cost Averaging
entity_data.content: Clare Francis, Investment Director at Barclays Smart Investor, recommends using a 'pound cost averaging' strategy. By investing a fixed amount of money at regular intervals (e.g., monthly), you buy more shares when prices are low and fewer when prices are high. This helps smooth out market volatility and reduces the risk of investing a large lump sum at the wrong time.

task_completion_criteria: Create a note summarizing recent advice on 'pound cost averaging' from Clare Francis, and set a reminder for April 18, 2026 at 9:00 AM to review this note.
